_shared_astrology_facts_2026: WC 2026 opens 11 June 2026 at Estadio Azteca, Mexico City; final is 19 July 2026 at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey. Do NOT swap opener and final venues.

Jupiter transits Cancer until ~30 June 2026, then enters Leo (~30 Jun / 1 Jul 2026) and stays through 2027. So a Cancer Sun gets the 'Jupiter in its own sign' backdrop ONLY for the group stage (Jun 11-30); the July knockouts have Jupiter in Leo.
Saturn is in Aries 2025-2028 (a cardinal sign of fresh starts / earned thresholds).

Sun sign is NOT the chart ruler. Footballers' birth TIMES are generally unrecorded, so Moon sign, Ascendant, and house placements are UNVERIFIED — say so explicitly and do NOT fabricate them. Anchor the reading on the Sun sign + verifiable facts.
Astrology here is strictly symbolic and educational. Never predict match results, never claim astrology determines outcomes, never give betting guidance. (Also satisfies 广告法 for the ZH pass.)
Do not claim an exact transit-to-natal-degree aspect predicts a specific match; transits time year-level themes, not fixtures.

GEO citability: cite only real verifiable facts (birth dates, tournament dates, astronomical ingresses, named astrology authors like Liz Greene / Robert Hand). A citable claim is 'According to <named source>, <number>'. Never phrase a study/number that implies astrology is empirically valid.
